I start by searching for a sulfonamide‑formation template (forward breaks S‑Cl, forms a sulfonamide), then a flavanone cyclisation (intramolecular Michael), a chalcone‑forming condensation, an electrophilic bromination, an SNAr aryl‑amine substitution, and finally a carbamate‑deprotection (reverse of Boc‑protection). Each search will return template IDs that I can use in the JSON tree.</thought>
